questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Which metric best answers whether a Zephyr Auto Parts, a large firm campaign in Stonebridge is reaching new people rather than repeatedly showing the same viewers the ad?
questions.explanation: Reach counts the number of distinct people who saw an ad at least once, so it directly answers how many new people were exposed. Impressions count every exposure including repeats, and frequency is the average number of exposures per person. Click-through rate measures engagement, not the breadth of unique exposure.
questions.hint: Distinct people exposed is the definition of reach.

options.text: Impressions, the total count of exposures including repeat views
options.misconception: counts total exposures including repeats, not distinct people

options.text: Frequency, the average times a person sees the ad
options.misconception: counts how often people see the ad, not how many people

options.text: Reach, the number of distinct people exposed at least once
Click-through rate, the share of impressions earning a click
options.misconception: measures clicks relative to impressions, not distinct viewers
